title: Chapter 259
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

The leader was heavily injured, and the Germinal Organization was in a mess. The situation suddenly changed.

Some of the troops rushed over to protect the leader, while others were still fighting with the reinforcements. The situation suddenly became chaotic. The experts of the Six Nations seized the opportunity and worked together to create a gap in the encirclement. They drove three cars and broke through the blockade.

"Get in the car quickly!" Tang Tang shouted.

The convoy was about to pass by Han Xiao. This was the best opportunity to get in the car.

Han Xiao looked in the direction of the leader. The reinforcements were blocking the leader behind them.

On one side was the leader, who had 14 percent of his health left and could not be killed in a short period of time. On the other side was the convoy that was about to break through the enemy's formation. The opportunity to end this operation was fleeting. If they delayed any longer, they would be caught again.

Han Xiao was not afraid. With his current strength, he could defeat the Germinal Organization alone. However, other than Bennett, the reinforcements were all injured. If they continued to fight, there would definitely be deaths.

He was the target of the reinforcements' protection, but now, he was the one protecting these helpers.

Han Xiao did not know whether to laugh or cry. He changed his mind and made a rational choice.

[The Traitor's Counterattack] mission has been completed. My job is done. As long as I give the information to the Six Nations, let them worry about what happens next.

He did not want to kill the leader anymore. It did not matter to him whether he killed the leader or not.

The convoy passed by, and the door opened. Han Xiao immediately jumped into the car and drove away.

The Germinal Organization's troops were completely left behind this time. They were gradually shrinking in his vision.

"It's over." Han Xiao finally heaved a sigh of relief. The leader had missed this opportunity and could not stop him anymore.

This time, it was really over.

In this operation, he had brought Aurora and Hella out of the headquarters, stolen a Mechanic class advanced knowledge, and obtained a bunch of crucial information that could decide the outcome of the battle. He had fought his way out and revealed his true colors. His Legendary Points were basically stable, and he had refreshed the players' impression of him. He had killed countless Germinal Organization Supers, successfully broke through the limit of Version 1.0, and finally defeated the leader. He was about to obtain two of his abilities.

Although he had encountered danger time and time again, he had earned a lot!

Han Xiaoxin suddenly wanted to see the expression on the leader's face, so he stuck his head out of the window and looked back.

On a sand dune in the distance, the leader clutched his chest and swayed unsteadily. His figure was bleak.

Looking into the distance, Han Xiao and the leader looked at each other.

The leader was expressionless. His fanfare was futile. He should have been excited, but Han Xiao saw a complicated emotion in his eyes. There was only pain, discouragement, dejection, and an indescribable sense of relief. It was as if he had exhausted his will to fight and no longer had the strength to feel hatred and anger.

Han Xiao was a little puzzled. He was suddenly curious about the experiences of the leader.

Leading the Germinal Organization, raising the flag of overthrowing the ideals of the Six Nations — why did he do all this? What kind of person was he?

Ambitious? Cruel and vicious? No bottom line?

They had been enemies for so long, but in reality, he knew very little about the leader.

"Right, I don't even know his name yet."

Han Xiao paused for a moment before looking over again.

The leader also looked at him from afar.

This exchange of glances was like pressing the pause button, freezing time and space. It was like turning into a painting.

This was the first time he had met the leader face to face.

It was also the last time.

Later, the experts of the Six Nations present repeated the experience of the operation and leaked it to the world.

After the war ended, the various countries found that this was the turning point of the entire war. The last gaze between Zero and the leader was of great historical significance, and it was recorded in the history of Blue Star.

…

At night, the stars were bright, and the moon was bright. The bright Milky Way hung high in the sky, and the clear silver light shone on the hills. There was no need for any other source of light to see clearly at night.

Three cars were parked at the top of a hill, hidden in the sparse forest. The engines were off, and the surroundings were quiet. Everyone got out of the cars and sat on one side, munching on dry food, bandaging their wounds, and whispering to each other.

After the fierce battle in the day, everyone decided to stop and rest. After driving out of the desert, they came to this hill. Further out was the edge of the battlefield between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization. The Germinal Organization's control in this area was limited, and the defense was not as tight as in the hinterland. The pursuit team mobilized by the leader had suffered heavy losses, and the road ahead was already smooth. This time, there would be no more accidents.
